kql.description: KQL query string to filter executions.

executedBy.description: Filter by the user who triggered the execution.

concurrencyGroupKey.description: Filter by evaluated concurrency group key.

startedAfter.description: Datemath lower bound for filtering executions by startedAt.

startedBefore.description: Datemath upper bound for filtering executions by startedAt.

finishedAfter.description: Datemath lower bound for filtering executions by finishedAt.

finishedBefore.description: Datemath upper bound for filtering executions by finishedAt.

collapse.description: Field to collapse execution results by.

sortField.description: Field to sort by. One of: startedAt, duration, workflowId, triggeredBy.

trackTotalHits.description: Whether to track total hit count.
